cases.title: Official Certificate of Marriage
cases.issuing_authority: Office of the Registrar General, Department of Civil Registration
narrative_blocks: This is to certify that Alexander Taylor and Elena Rostova were lawfully joined in marriage at Toronto, Ontario, Canada on the 10th day of June in the year 2023.
The marriage was solemnized under authority of License No. M-5891234 issued by the Registrar General, and officially registered on June 15, 2023 under Registration Number REG-2023-009412.

cases.title: Religious Solemnization Certificate
cases.issuing_authority: Community Religious Council of St. Jude

fields.marriage_certificate: Unregistered religious ceremony certificate without civil registry record

narrative_blocks: This document certifies that Julian Vance and Sophia Martinez solemnized a traditional religious ceremony at the Community Chapel on November 10, 2022.
Notice: This document is a religious ceremonial certificate and has not been registered with the Civil Registry of Marriages. Spousal status remains legally single under civil jurisdiction.

defect_spec.description: The provided marriage certificate represents a purely customary/religious ceremony that was never registered with the official civil registry, leaving the legal marital status as single/unregistered.

mutation_details.defect_reason: Lack of civil registry registration renders the religious ceremony legally unacknowledged for spousal immigration claims.

cases.title: Certificate of Marriage with Discrepant Name Records
narrative_blocks: This is to certify that David Miller and Sora Takahashi were legally married on August 1, 2021 at the Metropolitan Civil Registry Office.
Official records show spouse family name as Takahashi, whereas accompanying passport identity documents list the holder under the name Sora Kim without legal name change documentation.

defect_spec.description: Discrepancy in spouse family name between the marriage certificate (Sora Takahashi) and official passport details (Sora Kim) without connecting legal name change evidence.

mutation_details.defect_reason: Spouse family name on marriage certificate does not match name on passport and primary identification records.

cases.title: Remote Proxy Marriage Certificate
narrative_blocks: This certificate verifies that Lucas Bennett (located in Toronto, Canada) and Amara Okonkwo (located in Lagos, Nigeria) were solemnized in marriage via proxy videoconference on March 15, 2023.
Neither party was physically present together during or after the telecommunication ceremony, nor has physical cohabitation occurred post-solemnization.

defect_spec.description: The marriage was conducted remotely via proxy without physical presence of both parties together at the ceremony or subsequent physical cohabitation/consummation.

mutation_details.defect_reason: Proxy or remote marriages where parties were not physically present together are legally invalid for immigration purposes unless consummated.

cases.title: Foreign Marriage Certificate with Uncertified Translation
cases.issuing_authority: Oficina del Registro Civil, Ciudad de México

fields.document_translation: Informal machine translation without translator affidavit, certification stamp, or credentials

narrative_blocks: Certificado de Matrimonio expedido por la Oficina del Registro Civil de Ciudad de México.
An uncertified English translation generated via web translator was attached without a certified translator affidavit, oath, or contact information.

defect_spec.description: Foreign language marriage certificate provided with an informal uncertified translation lacking official translator affidavit and certification.

mutation_details.defect_reason: Foreign language documents must be accompanied by a certified translation and sworn affidavit from a qualified translator.
